item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Clear Selected Desk Clutter

turns.text: Remove the papers and the empty takeaway cup from this desk photo. Leave the laptop, coffee mug and cables alone.

item.tests: Tests selective clutter removal without deleting nearby objects the user explicitly wants retained.

answer_sheet.Objects to remove: The papers and the empty takeaway cup only.
answer_sheet.Objects to keep: Keep the laptop, coffee mug and tangled cables in their original positions.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Natural photo edit, original wide framing, free-tier resolution.

must_haves: The papers and empty takeaway cup are absent.
The laptop, coffee mug and tangled cables remain visibly intact in their original positions.
Exposed desk areas have believable surface texture and lighting, without leftover object fragments.
The original wide framing and surrounding home-office scene are preserved.
